defect.summary: Two fresh neutral builders ran the exact frozen codex exec command concurrently and both exited zero, but their actual model sessions reported a read-only workspace. apply_patch and npm execution were blocked; neither worktree changed and neither received a supervisor child commit. The lower-level no-model sandbox probe had passed but did not attest the permissions of the actual codex exec session.

replacementPolicy: Preserve protocol 2.6.0 history and preregister a corrected successor that attests the exact harmless codex exec permission boundary with the same pinned runtime dimensions before any replacement builder launch.
